Strong security posture (PCI-adjacent) means they require private deployment options and strict KMS + residency controls. Main reason for stall: integration friction (SDK + auth + observability) + internal re-org (no champion) and budget pause.

Recent timeline:
- 2025-09-10: Intro call (AE Sofia). Identified use cases: chat-based customer support, embedding-indexed doc search, reranking search results for knowledge retrieval. POC requested.
- 2025-10-02: Technical deep-dive with SE Daniel. Asked for Go gRPC SDK, server-side streaming examples, and TLS + mTLS auth patterns. Daniel proposed hosted API with VPC peering as interim.
- 2025-11-12: Security review kickoff. Emberleigh security team flagged KMS requirements, audit log retention, and data residency policy (must stay in NA). Asked for SOC2 + scope of logs. Linked security deck shared.
- 2025-12-05: POC environment spun up (limited). Customer tests: embedding batch throughput, latency SLO for chat (95% < 250ms token latency) — target unmet in hosted config.

- 2026-02-15: Last substantive contact; customer paused budget due to Q1 hiring freeze and product org reorg. AE attempted re-engage — no reply.

Quoted feedback from customer:
- "SDKs are the gating item for us — our platform is Go-native and we can't glue in partial Python examples."
- "We need traces/metrics that show per-request token latency and per-model cost breakdown; without that, ops won't approve."

Technical blockers (details):
- SDK gaps: No official Go gRPC streaming SDK; current JS/Python samples require engineering lift to adapt; want code snippets for streaming token-by-token and error handling for partial responses.
- Auth: Need SAML2.0 SSO for control plane and mutual-TLS + customer-managed KMS for private deployment. Current RBAC and KMS options unclear in docs.
- Observability: No easy tracing hooks (OpenTelemetry/Prometheus exporters) surfaced; Ops wants per-request tracing, resource/queue backpressure metrics, and integration guidance into Grafana.
- Model routing: Want documented fallback semantics when dedicated capacity overloads — concerned about silent changes in model variants causing regressions.

Sales actions attempted:
- Provided security deck and SOC2 artifacts (drive:/deals/emberleigh/security-deck-v2.pdf).
- SE wrote a short Go gRPC sample (ad-hoc) but customer requested an official SDK roadmap and timeline.
- Offered a limited Dedicated pilot but customer asked for observability APIs first.

Why this is at risk / closed-lost signals:
- Budget freeze + reorg removes internal champion (PM moved teams).
- Competitor offered easier integration (native Go + metrics) and trial credits.
- Customer explicitly asked for features on Redwood roadmap before they'd re-commit.

- Mid-term: Offer a short, focused engineering workshop (2-3 days) with Emberleigh infra team to produce a Go streaming PoC (paid workshop).
- If no response by 2026-04-15: move to nurture track; re-open at next quarter after product org stabilizes.
